name: 3Min API
description:
3Min API turns a plain-language description into a working REST API endpoint — no backend code to write or host.

Describe what you want to collect (inquiries, orders, signups) and an endpoint goes live. Define a JSON schema if you want field validation, or skip it to accept any payload. Every endpoint comes with full CRUD operations, separate sandbox and production environments, searchable call logs, and usage statistics. New records reach your own system by webhook, or by polling when your server can't be reached from the internet.

With Tasks, you can also hand a job to a worker you run on your own server — such as an AI agent — and check the result right in the chat. 3Min API delivers the job and records its status; the work itself runs on your server.

With this connector you can:

• Create, update, and deploy endpoints — one sentence is enough, and each new endpoint is automatically verified with a test call
• Send real requests to your own endpoint (create, read, update, delete) to confirm it works before going live
• Search everything you have received by keyword across the entire payload, or look up a single record
• Start jobs on your workers, check their progress and results, and cancel them
• Track monthly and daily usage with success rates and response times
• Issue scoped access keys for partners and control exactly which operations each one may perform

Every action is scoped to your own account; other users' resources are never reachable. Sign-in uses OAuth, so no API keys are exchanged in conversation, and responses mask sensitive values such as access keys and collaborator email addresses — full values remain available only on the web dashboard. Webhook authentication headers and task worker credentials are likewise set only on the dashboard and are never requested in conversation.

Deleting an endpoint, registering task workers, changing plans, and billing are handled on the web dashboard, not through this connector.

_published_faq.name: How do I add 3Min API to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add 3Min API to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://3minapi.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the 3Min API MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: 3Min API lists 13 MCP tools, including api_call, collaborators, endpoints, help, logs, stats, subscription, task_cancel, task_create, task_get, task_list, and wordpress_plugin.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to 3Min API?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to 3Min API in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
3Min API requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
3Min API is developed by Maverick Works. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
